test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Number of wickets taken by six bowlers Anil, Kamal, Laxman, Mohan, Bittu and Rahul are compared. Number of wickets taken by Kamal are more than only the number of wickets taken by Anil. Number of wickets taken by Bittu are less than only two bowlers. Number of wickets taken by Mohan are not more than Bittu. Who among the following has taken more wickets than Bittu?
solution:
Given: Six bowlers Anil, Kamal, Laxman, Mohan, Bittu and Rahul.

1) Number of wickets taken by Bittu are less than only two bowlers.

_____ > _____ > Bittu > _____ > _____ > _____

2) Number of wickets taken by Kamal are more than only the number of wickets taken by Anil.

_____ > _____ > Bittu > _____ > Kamal > Anil

3) Number of wickets taken by Mohan are not more than Bittu.

Rahul/Laxman > Rahul/Laxman > Bittu > Mohan > Kamal > Anil

Here, Either Rahul or Laxman has taken more wickets than Bittu,

But, Laxman is not given in the option, so take 'Rahul' as the answer.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
